items.title: Empacer
items.source_text: Empacer  The voice-first assistant for small business owners Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval. Productivity SaaS Artificial Intelligence

items.title: Scape
items.source_text: Scape An intelligent email inbox that works for you Imagine opening your inbox and finding everything already organized, with replies ready to review. Scape is an intelligent email client that prioritizes messages, prepares contextual drafts, and helps track conversations and follow-ups. It understands your work across emails, meetings, calendars, and attachments, so you can spend less time managing communication and more time moving work forward. Email Artificial Intelligence Design

items.title: Gologin Cloud Browser
items.source_text: Gologin Cloud Browser Cloud browser for AI agents and tough sites  Gologin Cloud Browser gives AI agents and scrapers real Chromium browsers that stay logged in. Persistent sessions survive across runs, so there’s no re-auth or lost state. Built-in stealth and anti-bot protection, plus proxies in 150+ countries. Fully serverless, it scales to thousands of browsers and works with Playwright and Puppeteer via WebSocket. Built by the GoLogin team: 7 years’ expertise, SOC 2 Type II, 99.9% SLA. Plans from $4.50/mo. SaaS Developer Tools Artificial Intelligence
